metadata.notes: Added 2026-08-14 as the concrete proof, not just an assertion, that action.ts's requiredToolCapabilities actually generalizes FRY/PAR_FRY beyond the one hardcoded 'pan' id — a wok is a real, physically distinct vessel from pan.json (deep, curved sides vs. flat, shallow-sided) that a real kitchen genuinely treats as interchangeable with a frying pan for shallow/stir-frying work, the same role saucepan.json plays for BOIL/SIMMER/PASTEURIZE's isDeepVessel. See scripts/fry-egg-as-a-robot.ts for FRY actually executing against this entity, not just this file declaring the capability.
